how_to_apply: Download the application form from the AIIMS Bibinagar research opportunities page. The form is also printed at the end of the notification.
Fill in and sign the form in the prescribed format. Do not change the serial number order or the column headings. You may add extra sheets as annexures if needed.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bibinagar
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar is located in the Hyderabad Metropolitan Region of Telangana. This post belongs to the ICMR-funded project "Capacity Building Project for Managing Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) Outbreaks in Tertiary and Secondary Care Hospitals across India - A Hub and Spoke Model as part of Capacity Building Program for Pandemic Preparedness (CBPPP) under PMABHIM". The project runs in the institute's Department of Microbiology.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bibinagar Project Technical Support-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates need one of the following: Three Years Graduate degree in Medical Microbiology/ Life Sciences/ Epidemiology/ Public Health + Two years experience in relevant subject OR 12th in Science + Diploma (DMLT or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in Medical Microbiology/ Microbiology/ Life Sciences Qualifications obtained through distance education will not be considered. Experience in the health sector, ICMR, AIIMS, NHM, CTD, NACO, etc., or in scientific departments or organisations, with experience in project management Prior involvement in Hospital Infection Control/AMP/AMSP research projects Prior experience in training or coordinating Infection Prevention Control (IPC) programs Experience in coordinating and conducting IPC trainings and audits Basic knowledge of data analysis platforms such as Excel, SPSS and Epi Info Knowledge of computer applications or Business Intelligence tools such as Microsoft Excel and PPT Read the official notification for the full discipline-wise eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Completing any work assigned by the PI and Co-PI so that the project runs smoothly Coordinating project work across ICMR, AIIMS Delhi and 10 secondary care hospitals Teaching nursing and lab staff about all relevant project activities Making data entries in the project forms Organising workshops and awareness programmes Preparing project reports and handling project documents Writing research articles for publication in reputed journals

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection committee will check the applications it receives. Recruitment will be made through an interview. A written test will be held if there are more than 50 eligible candidates for the post. Selection is purely on merit. The interview is held in person only. Requests for an online interview will not be considered. No separate communication will be sent to candidates. Selected candidates will be informed by email.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely contractual and is first given for 1.5 months. If performance is satisfactory, the PI may recommend extending the contract until the project ends. The post is not on the AIIMS Bibinagar payroll. Employment ends automatically when the contract term is over. Candidates have no claim to permanent employment at AIIMS Bibinagar or with the principal investigator. The place of posting is the Department of Microbiology, AIIMS Bibinagar, Telangana.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the AIIMS Bibinagar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 2 November 2026 (Monday), after 10 AM. It will be held at the Department of Microbiology, 2nd Floor, Academic Building, AIIMS Bibinagar.

faq.question: Q2. By what time must I submit the application?
faq.answer: Hand in the completed form with self-attested copies in person on 2 November 2026, before 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Do I also have to send the form by email?
faq.answer: Yes. Email the filled form and all supporting documents as a single PDF to [email protected] before the walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: The consolidated fixed pay is Rs. 20,000 plus 30% HRA, which comes to Rs. 26,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Can a DMLT holder apply?
faq.answer: Yes. You need 12th in Science, a Diploma (DMLT or equivalent) and five years of experience in Medical Microbiology, Microbiology or Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q6. Are distance education degrees accepted?
faq.answer: No. The notice says distance educational qualifications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first contract is for 1.5 months. If your performance is satisfactory, the PI may recommend extending it until the project ends.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: A written test will be held only if there are more than 50 eligible candidates for the post. Otherwise, selection is through the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What should I write on the application envelope?
faq.answer: Write the full project title, "Capacity Building Project for Managing Healthcare-Associated Infection (HAI) Outbreaks ... under PMABHIM". Below it, write "Post code-III, Department of Microbiology, AIIMS, Bibinagar".

faq.question: Q10. Will travel expenses be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.
